This file is source-authority for Plan/Spec and downstream RED fanout only; it does not claim runtime/product readiness.

acceptance_criteria.given: a meet, messenger huddle, live broadcast, screen capture, or manual upload recording is finalized
acceptance_criteria.when: recordings accepts the ingest request or consumed event
acceptance_criteria.then: tenant_id, source_kind, content_hash, context_kind, consent_banner_confirmed, cell_id, and parent audit-chain reference are recorded and the ingest is idempotent by tenant plus source/idempotency key

acceptance_criteria.given: a user lists, reads, plays, or searches recordings
acceptance_criteria.when: request headers and resource scope are evaluated
acceptance_criteria.then: mTLS identity, X-Oyatie-Tenant, X-Oyatie-Pack, Cedar policy, share-link constraints, and context boundary decide access before any media/transcript bytes are exposed

acceptance_criteria.given: a transcript, translation, summary, or redaction overlay is produced
acceptance_criteria.when: derived content is stored or emitted
acceptance_criteria.then: derived content binds to the source recording content_hash, records model/version or reviewer reason, emits audit/event evidence, and never mutates immutable source media

acceptance_criteria.given: a recording is under legal hold, regulated WORM profile, statutory floor, or active DSR/purge review
acceptance_criteria.when: retention, purge, redaction, export, or release actions run
acceptance_criteria.then: ADR-REC-001 mode matrix, two-person approvals, Cedar roles, audit-chain seals, search-index purge ordering, and proof-of-erasure or chain-of-custody records are enforced

acceptance_criteria.given: an eDiscovery or regular export is requested
acceptance_criteria.when: the export bundle is queued or completed
acceptance_criteria.then: bundle contents, signed URL expiry, watermark/viewer constraints, Merkle root, hold/export scope, requester, paired approver, and audit-chain seal are recorded without leaking unauthorized media/transcript bytes

acceptance_criteria.given: recordings user-facing UI paths are implemented later
acceptance_criteria.when: playback, transcript search, share-link, redaction, retention, legal-hold, or export journeys are exercised
acceptance_criteria.then: browser/user-story evidence proves WCAG 2.2 AA keyboard/screen-reader coverage, visible consent/policy disclosure, responsive layout, localized KR/en-US basics, and clear denied/error states
acceptance_criteria.planned_verification_ref: future Build/Review browser and accessibility evidence; not satisfied by this source-lock file

security_privacy_regulatory.regulated_claim_boundary: This file identifies required regulatory posture and evidence targets. It does not claim compliance certification, production legal-hold correctness, SEC 17a-4(f) readiness, HIPAA production safeguards, GDPR/PIPA production erasure fulfillment, or measured controls.

user_experience.accessibility_coverage: WCAG 2.2 AA minimum for all future recordings user/admin paths; keyboard, screen-reader, reduced-motion, caption/transcript, visible focus, high-contrast, and error-state coverage required.
user_experience.internationalization_scope: KR and en-US launch coverage; EU locale readiness through regional packs; transcript language display uses BCP 47 codes.

risks.risk: recording source media or transcripts leak across tenant, pack, context, share-link, or legal-hold boundaries
risks.mitigation: mTLS, tenant/pack headers, Cedar deny-by-default, share-link expiry/revocation, and RED access-denial fixtures before Build

risks.risk: legal hold, regulated WORM, or eDiscovery chain-of-custody is bypassed by purge, redaction, export, or mutable correction paths
risks.mitigation: ADR-REC-001 mode matrix, four-eyes approvals, non-destructive overlays, Merkle export bundle, audit-chain seals, and legal-hold correctness fixtures

risks.risk: existing inventory overclaims GA/IP/SLO readiness without current source authority or runtime evidence
risks.mitigation: this PRD sets source-authority claim ceiling; downstream gates must replay contracts and produce runtime evidence before readiness claims

risks.risk: retired dependency vocabulary routes work to stale ownership or infrastructure
risks.mitigation: normalize retired token to intelligence authority and treat historical references as cleanup/provenance until dedicated migration cards update service-home files

risks.risk: large media/transcript workloads create unbounded cost or processing backlog
risks.mitigation: per-tenant storage/minutes/export metering, queue backpressure, transcription degraded runbooks, and SLO/metric gates

best_practices.rule: recording ingest is idempotent and content-hash verified before downstream processing
legal hold and eDiscovery require four-eyes approval plus audit-chain seal
redactions are overlays and do not mutate source media in WORM or legal-hold contexts
share links are scoped, expiring, revocable, watermarkable, and never bypass tenant policy
retired/provenance service tokens are normalized to current authorities before assignment or implementation
